_about: Batch B1 writer (learn/what-an-llm-does, tokens, transformer, attention, prefill-decode, sampling). Reuse ids from the other glossary files; do not redefine them here.

vocabulary.short: The fixed list of all tokens that a tokenizer and a model know. Each token has one id from 0 to vocab_size − 1.
vocabulary.long: DeepInfer reads vocab_size from the checkpoint config ({{cite deepinfer/hugging_face/config.py:276}}). The tokenizer reserves ids 129280-129300 for multimodal tokens ({{cite deepinfer/hugging_face/tokenizer.py:25-30}}).

bpe.short: Byte-pair encoding. A tokenizer method that starts from bytes and learns merge rules: it merges the most frequent pair of neighbours again and again.

special-token.short: A token with a control meaning, not normal text, for example BOS (begin of sequence), EOS (end of sequence) or PAD. In DeepInfer they have the ids 0, 1 and 2.

transformer.short: The neural network design of almost all LLMs: an embedding, a stack of layers that each do attention and a feed-forward network, and an output head.

residual-stream.short: The hidden state that flows from layer to layer. Each block reads it, computes something, and adds the result back to it (a residual connection).

softmax.short: A function that turns a list of scores into probabilities: exp(score) divided by the sum of all exp values. The results are positive and add up to 1.

causal-mask.short: The rule that a token can attend only to itself and to earlier tokens. Attention gives the scores of later tokens the value −∞, so their weight is 0.

gqa.short: Grouped-query attention: query heads are split into groups, and each group shares one key head and one value head. It needs fewer KV cache bytes than full multi-head attention.

mha.short: Attention with several heads in parallel. Each head has its own queries, keys and values; the outputs of all heads are joined and projected.

autoregressive.short: Generation one token at a time, where each new token is added to the input before the model makes the next one.

greedy-decoding.short: Always pick the token with the highest probability. In DeepInfer, temperature 0 gives almost this behaviour: tokens with exactly equal logits still share the probability.
greedy-decoding.long: SamplingParams replaces a temperature below 1e-5 with 1e-5 and turns off top-p and top-k ({{cite deepinfer/sampling_params.py:76-79}}).

sampling.short: The step that selects the next token from the probabilities of the model, with settings such as temperature, top-k and top-p.

ttft.short: Time to first token: the time from the arrival of a request to its first output token. It is the wait before the prefill step plus the prefill time.

tbt.short: Time between tokens: the time from one output token of a request to the next. Decode step time sets it. Also called TPOT or ITL.

model-weights.short: The learned numbers of a model (also called parameters), stored as large matrices. Each forward pass reads them from device memory.
